title: Package delivery notification

messages.text: Address incomplete. Pay $2.99 fee to reschedule: https://nexatrust-delvry.com/pkg/9x4k2
Thanks! Where can I track it?
Check the Mailroom portal anytime or call Reception at ext. 2500.

explainPoints: Suspicious sender format: 'NexaTrust-Delivery' with a hyphen instead of 'NexaTrust Mailroom'.
Unknown number: Official messages come from the company's verified short code +1 (555) 0123.
First message is suspicious: The urgent 'URGENT' and 'failed' language creates panic, while the legitimate version is friendly and informative.
Malicious link with payment: The URL nexatrust-delvry.com is fake and asks for money. Real tracking is free through the portal.
